about: Final regular-season NRL ladders 1998-2026 (position 1 = minor premiers), as published on each season's Wikipedia article. Used for the club-finish adjustment in scripts/nrl/build-nrl-ratings.ts.
notes: Ladders are as published (after any points deductions, e.g. Canterbury 2002 last; Melbourne 2007/2008 minor premierships later stripped but kept here as on-field finish).
